import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
cs=['ьъъъ','ь','ь','ъъъ','ъъьь','ъъъ','ъъ','ьъ','ь']
for n,(x,c) in enumerate(zip(r[85:],cs),86):
 a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):v for i,v in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='no' if n in [88,94] else 'yes',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(r)==len(a),(len(r),len(a))
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected,(x,y)
 assert set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
print('Verified count, order, slot coverage:',len(a))
print('Slot calls:',dict(collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
